No human reviewed or tested anything, no hardware was attached, no --backend hardware or --allow-hardware was run, and no ROS graph, Unity scene, simulator or hardware run is claimed.

RECON AND SCOPE: The pinned repository is a ROS 1 catkin workspace plus a Unity 3D scene for unmanned underwater vehicles. The card's entry_symbols list is empty, so there is no Python entry symbol to verify; the card's family:ros / RosDriver decision matches the actual ROS 1 topics and is used without deviation. This is a configuration-only RosDriver over rosbridge; it declares no Python native class and neither imports nor launches the clone. AUV.Start registers the CompressedImage, Depth and Heading publishers plus the Thruster and Imu subscriber callbacks (unity/Assets/Scripts/AUV.cs:24-32). The package exposes three explicit fresh-subscription observations: /depth (std_msgs/Float64), /imu/HeadingTrue_degree (std_msgs/Float64) and /imu/data (sensor_msgs/Imu). The exact topics and types are the absolute literals declared by DepthPublisher.cs:9-13, HeadingPublisher.cs:10-16 and imuPublisher.cs:9-13. It is mode simulated, device kind world.sim, risk R0. The main resource has no automatic reads; each observation opens a new subscription, so a silent publisher fails only that observation at its deadline and never returns a held sample. The operator must run Unity, the ROS graph and rosbridge separately; no namespace or remapping is assumed beyond the absolute topics in the clone.

PUBLISHER STATE: AUV.Update leaves every telemetry StartCoroutine call (image, depth, IMU and heading) commented out (unity/Assets/Scripts/AUV.cs:40-47). The pinned scene therefore declares the publishers but starts no stream. The fake answers each subscription with one placeholder sample; a live deployment must start a publisher or enable the coroutines. The /depth value is vehicle.transform.position.y (AUV.cs:78-84), the heading is transform.rotation.eulerAngles.y (AUV.cs:114-123), and the IMU sample carries the vehicle quaternion with zero angular-velocity and linear-acceleration vectors (AUV.cs:87-111). No unit, datum, frame or sample age beyond those literals is inferred.

CONTROL BLOCKER: The Unity scene accepts eight thruster forces on /thruster with thrusters/ThrusterMsg (unity/Assets/Subscribers/ThrusterCallback.cs:20-25, 52-73), but the ROS publisher is not runnable: ros/src/control/scripts/thruster.py:4 imports a nonexistent thrusterMsg class and line 10 passes an undefined 'thruster' name to rospy.Publisher. The six action definitions carry only a float final result and no success/failure field (for example ros/src/control/action/heave.action:4-5); the heave server uses an undefined Float64 name, reads self.heave before assignment, references an undefined successt name and an undefined req name, and has no set_aborted path (ros/src/control/servers/heave.py:12-37); the roll server is a rospy.Service, not an action server (servers/roll.py:2-11). The control CMake list contains no stop, pause or reset action (CMakeLists.txt:58-68), and the package contains no stop/pause/reset/step service. A neutral /thruster publication is transmission-only and is not an acknowledged stop. A control binding would therefore make the stock e-stop fail MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED rather than prove a stop, so it is deliberately not bound. This is the concrete pinned-source reason the package serves the observation profile; if the orchestrator requires the motion/control surface, this card should be treated as HELPER_MISSING rather than accepting the observation profile as full task control.

CAMERA NOT COVERED: CompressedImagePublisher declares /image/compressed with sensor_msgs/CompressedImage (CompressedImagePublisher.cs:9-13), and AUV.SendImage reads a 640x480 RGB24 texture and publishes JPEG (AUV.cs:54-75). Its coroutine is commented out (AUV.cs:40-47). cap.sensing.image.v1 binds the sensor.camera resource kind, which does not match this world.sim device, and the RosDriver image-artifact path is restricted to cap.sensing.image.v1, so an x-cap image binding is refused. No image artifact, frame size, codec behavior, exposure or camera calibration is claimed. /depth is a scalar std_msgs/Float64 topic, not a depth camera, and no point cloud is derived from it. The extension x-cap ids used here are requested in catalogue_requests.

SAFETY: mode simulated, risk R0 (the card floor). Only topic observations are bound; there is no motion, actuation, writable parameter or native reset. A stock e-stop is the runtime software latch and reports estop=software_only; no native stop, simulator pause or physical e-stop is declared or claimed. The extension read capabilities remain latched after an e-st [...]

The scene connects to a hard-coded rosbridge at ws://192.168.0.100:9090.
